victory.text: The staff is yours. The gate can be closed.

fighter.name: Fighter
fighter.blurb: Front rank. Hits things until they stop.

mage.name: Wizard
mage.blurb: Fragile. Ends fights early when it works.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.blurb: Back rank. Finds the traps, opens the locks, and knifes whatever the front rank is busy with.

it.dagger.name: Dagger
it.dagger.desc: Deals 1d4. worn in the weapon slot.

it.club.name: Club
it.club.desc: Deals 1d6. worn in the weapon slot.

it.shortsword.name: Short Sword
it.shortsword.desc: Deals 1d6. worn in the weapon slot.

it.mace.name: Mace
it.mace.desc: Deals 1d6+1. worn in the weapon slot.

it.longsword.name: Long Sword
it.longsword.desc: Deals 1d8. worn in the weapon slot.

it.flail.name: Flail
it.flail.desc: Deals 1d8+1. worn in the weapon slot.

it.greatsword.name: Greatsword
it.greatsword.desc: Two hands, and worth both of them.

it.quarterstaff.name: Quarterstaff
it.quarterstaff.desc: Deals 1d6. worn in the weapon slot.

it.sling.name: Sling
it.sling.desc: Deals 1d4. worn in the weapon slot, can be used from the back rank.

it.shortbow.name: Short Bow
it.shortbow.desc: Strike from the back rank. Light enough for anyone.

it.longbow.name: Long Bow
it.longbow.desc: The best reach in the game, but it needs a strong arm.

it.crossbow.name: Crossbow
it.crossbow.desc: Slow to wind, brutal when it lands. Priests may use it.

it.padded.name: Padded Coat
it.padded.desc: +1 defence. worn in the armor slot.

it.leather.name: Leather Jack
it.leather.desc: +2 defence. worn in the armor slot.

it.ringmail.name: Ring Mail
it.ringmail.desc: +4 defence. worn in the armor slot.

it.scalemail.name: Scale Mail
it.scalemail.desc: +5 defence. worn in the armor slot.

it.chainmail.name: Chain Mail
it.chainmail.desc: +6 defence. worn in the armor slot.

it.buckler.name: Buckler
it.buckler.desc: +1 defence. worn in the shield slot.

it.kiteshield.name: Kite Shield
it.kiteshield.desc: +2 defence. worn in the shield slot.

it.towershield.name: Tower Shield
it.towershield.desc: +3 defence. worn in the shield slot.

it.potion.name: Healing Draught
it.potion.desc: Restores body. The common draught; every delver carries one.

it.potion2.name: Strong Draught
it.potion2.desc: A stronger draught, worth the extra gold before a hard floor.

it.ether.name: Clear Ether (magic)
it.ether.desc: Restores magic points. This is what your casters want.

it.ether2.name: Deep Ether (magic)
it.ether2.desc: A deeper draught of the same. Restores a good deal of magic.

it.antidote.name: Antidote
it.antidote.desc: Lifts poison. Cheap, and worth carrying two.

it.holywater.name: Holy Water
it.holywater.desc: Thrown, not drunk. Burns the restless especially.

it.torch.name: Pitch Torch
it.torch.desc: Light for forty turns. Floor two is dark without one.

it.ring.ward.name: Ring of Warding
it.ring.ward.desc: A plain iron band. +1 defence to whoever wears it.

it.charm.luck.name: Charm of Fortune
it.charm.luck.desc: A knuckle of something, on a thong. It helps, a little.

it.key.rust.name: Rusted Key
it.key.rust.desc: A rusted key. It opens one door in the tower.

it.key.bronze.name: Bronze Key
it.key.bronze.desc: A bronze key, greened with age.

it.key.warden.name: Warden's Key
it.key.warden.desc: The warden's own key. It opens the deep vault.

it.scroll.recall.name: Scroll of Recall
it.scroll.recall.desc: Speaks the word for you. Takes the party home from any depth.

it.throwingAxe.name: Throwing Axe
it.throwingAxe.desc: Thrown from the back rank, or swung from the front.

it.morningstar.name: Morning Star
it.morningstar.desc: Flanged and unkind. Blunt, so a priest may use it.

it.scale.name: Scale Hauberk
it.scale.desc: +4 defence. Heavier than mail, and better.

it.plate.name: Plate Harness
it.plate.desc: +6 defence. What a levelled fighter is saving for.

it.ring.iron.name: Ring of the Vigil
it.ring.iron.desc: +1 defence, and a little steadier in a fight.

it.amulet.bear.name: Bear's Tooth
it.amulet.bear.desc: +2 defence. Heavy on the chest, heavier on the purse.

it.amulet.ward.name: Amulet of Warding
it.amulet.ward.desc: +3 defence. Old work, and nobody knows whose.

it.charm.quick.name: Quickening Charm
it.charm.quick.desc: +1 defence. It makes the wearer a half-step faster.

it.scroll.fire.name: Scroll of Cinders
it.scroll.fire.desc: Anyone can read it. Burns one enemy from any rank. Once.

it.scroll.mend.name: Scroll of Mending
it.scroll.mend.desc: Anyone can read it. Mends one ally, whether or not they can cast.

it.scroll.light.name: Scroll of Lanterns
it.scroll.light.desc: Light for eighty turns, without spending a spell.

it.scroll.reveal.name: Charcoal Map
it.scroll.reveal.desc: Somebody walked this floor before you and wrote it down.

it.wand.spark.name: Wand of Sparks
it.wand.spark.desc: Five charges. A fighter holding this is a second archer.

it.ether3.name: Great Ether (magic)
it.ether3.desc: Restores a great deal of magic. Expensive, and worth it before a boss.

it.rope.name: Rope and Grapnel
it.rope.desc: Fifty feet and a hook. Throw it over a gap one square wide and climb across, or go down a pit hand over hand instead of falling.

it.crowbar.name: Crowbar
it.crowbar.desc: Iron, bent at one end. Forces a lock, loudly, and helps under a portcullis.

it.oil.name: Flask of Oil
it.oil.desc: Lit and thrown: 2d6 fire, and a troll stops mending. Facing webs, it burns them away.

it.caltrops.name: Caltrops
it.caltrops.desc: A bag of iron jacks scattered before the line. Their melee is −2 for three rounds, and if you run, nothing follows.

it.ring.fumble.name: Ring of Fumbling
it.ring.fumble.desc: Cursed. −2 to hit, and it will not come off until Mitz lifts the curse.

it.ring.smoke.name: Ring of Smoke
it.ring.smoke.desc: +2 defence. Blows seem to find the wearer a moment late.

it.ring.lead.name: Ring of Lead
it.ring.lead.desc: Cursed. −2 defence, and it will not come off until Mitz lifts the curse.

it.spear.name: Spear
it.spear.desc: Deals 1d6. A polearm: in a narrow passage, or from the back rank, it reaches past the two in front (at −1 to hit).

it.lucerne.name: Lucerne Hammer
it.lucerne.desc: Deals 1d8. A blunt polearm, so a priest may use it, and it reaches past the two in front (at −1 to hit).

it.halberd.name: Halberd
it.halberd.desc: Deals 1d10+1. Axe, hook and spike on a long haft; it reaches past the two in front (at −1 to hit).

phases.text: The Chief bellows. Something answers from the tunnels.
The runes across the vault blaze white. The Shade straightens.
The dragon rears back. The air between you turns to shimmer.

chest: Check it for wires before you touch it.
inscription: Copy it down. We can puzzle it out later.
stairs: Nothing good has ever been up.
wounded: I can keep going. For a while.
Do not slow down on my account.
close: I need a moment I do not have.

inscription: Does it say where the gold is?
stairs: Let's see what's got the nerve to live down there.
monster: Oh good, I was getting bored.
wounded: That one got lucky. It happens.
close: That one stung. I'm fine. I'm fine.

chest: The lockwork is older than the tower.
Look at the hinges — this was reused.
inscription: The grammar is wrong. Deliberately, I think.
stairs: The stonework changes here. Different builders.
These steps were cut in a hurry.
monster: I'd rather like to study one, afterwards.
wounded: I appear to be bleeding. Interesting.
That was a poor outcome. Noted.
floor: The air moves. There is another way out.
kill: So that's how they come apart.
I'll want a look at that later.
close: I'm losing rather a lot of blood.
This is less theoretical than I would like.

chest: Someone lost this. I hope they were long gone.
Take what we need. Only that.
inscription: A name. Just a name, and a date.
stairs: We can turn back. Nobody would think less of us.
monster: It isn't, is it. Very well.
wounded: I really don't think we should keep going.
Please. Just a moment to breathe.
floor: Something here has been denied its proper rest.
This place was a home once.
kill: I'm sorry it came to that.
crit: I didn't want to do that.
close: Don't let them reach the others.

temple.line: Mitz keeps the lamps lit and asks few questions.

shop.line: Simz weighs everything twice and still smiles.

hall.name: The Entry Hall
hall.look: Daylight reaches a few feet in and gives up. The floor is swept — recently.

gallery.name: North Gallery
gallery.look: A long gallery. Sconces every ten feet, all of them cold.

refectory.name: The Refectory
refectory.look: Benches shoved against the walls. Something has been eating here.

stair.name: The Stair Head
stair.look: The air from below is colder and smells of wet stone.

5,6.text: A shield line, and bowmen behind it.

4,5.text: A plank door, warped and pegged shut with a rusted lock.

1,5.text: Scratches on the stone. Someone counted the days here, and stopped.

3,3.text: An iron lever, seized with rust.
3,3.note: Somewhere below, a grate grinds open.

6,9.text: A grate, closed. The lever must be elsewhere.

1,1.text: A rusted blade snaps out of the wall.

7,1.text: A sigil cut deep into the flagstone.

5,1.text: A flagstone sits a finger proud of the rest.

4,9.text: A delver who came before you, slumped against the wall, pack still on.

8,9.text: The wall to the south is painted on the dark. Your hand goes through it.

tunnels.name: Natural Tunnels
tunnels.look: The cut stone gives out. From here the walls are raw rock, damp to the touch.

den.name: The Chief’s Den
den.look: Hides on the floor and a chair built from a broken door.

dark.name: The Lightless Run
dark.look: Your lantern shows nothing but the next few feet. Something is breathing.

cistern.name: The Cistern
cistern.look: Black water, perfectly still, reflecting a ceiling you cannot see.

7,2.text: A door of lashed timber, barred from this side.

5,6.text: A bronze-bound door, cold to the touch.

3,5.text: The floor gives way onto rusted spikes.

2,2.text: A tally scratched in charcoal. It stops abruptly at forty-one.

9,9.text: A seam in the masonry, barely a finger wide.

4,3.text: A sluice handle, thick with silt.

7,9.text: A flooded arch. Impassable until the water drops.

4,4.text: The passage turns, or you do. Hard to say which.

6,8.text: The flagstone tips and drops you into the dark.

9,4.text: A woman in a delver’s coat, chained to a ring in the wall. The goblins were saving her.

10,10.text: A tinker sits on his pack in the corner, where the goblins leave him be. Trade is trade.

10,4.text: A net drops from the roof, weighted with stones.

1,8.text: A hiss from the floor, and the air turns sweet and thick.

1,5.text: A door hung to swing one way. It shuts behind you, and there is no handle on this side.

antechamber.name: The Antechamber
antechamber.look: Shelves of jars, every one empty, every one labelled in the same hand.

scriptorium.name: The Scriptorium
scriptorium.look: Desks in rows. The ink in every well is long dry and the chairs face the door.

ossuary.name: The Ossuary
ossuary.look: Bones stacked with real care, sorted by size, filling the walls to the ceiling.

lab.name: The Laboratory
lab.look: A vaulted room, dark as a closed eye. Something at the far end is faintly humming.

6,6.text: A door of black iron. No handle, only a warden’s plate.

3,2.text: A ledger, open. Every entry is a name, and every name is struck through.

5,5.text: A ward hangs across the arch. It does not know you.
5,5.openText: The ward reads the binding in your memory and thins away.

9,9.text: The Staff of Ashkeld rests on its cradle, humming faintly.

2,6.note: Fresh air moves. A shaft has opened.

riddle.q: Every line begins with a name and ends the same way. Ashkeld kept one for each of you. What is it?

3,3.text: A stone scholar with an open book, its mouth carved mid-word.

4,7.text: An altar of yellowed bone, a bowl worn smooth in its top.

10,5.text: A jet of flame from a vent in the wall.

2,5.text: A portcullis, its teeth sunk in the floor. Something elsewhere raises it.

1,7.text: A plate in the floor, worn bright by feet.

ev.well.title: The Dry Well
ev.well.text: A well shaft, bone dry. A frayed rope disappears into the dark, and something down there catches the light.

effects.text: A satchel, its owner long gone.
The rope comes up. A boot is tied to the end of it.

ev.cistern.title: The Cistern
ev.cistern.text: Black water, perfectly still. Shapes rest on the bottom, just out of reach.

effects.text: Something cold closes on your wrist, then lets go. The water is not clean.

ev.throne.title: The Frost-Rimed Chair
ev.throne.text: A tall chair stands against the north wall, rimed white. Runes have been cut into both arms.

effects.text: A binding. Ashkeld was not the one who wrote it.
The cold goes through you and stays.
The runes split. Something distant notices.

ev.shrine1.title: A Roadside Shrine
ev.shrine1.text: A niche in the wall, a worn figure inside, a shallow bowl in front of it.

effects.text: The ache goes out of your legs.
You feel steadier. It may be nothing.
The bowl is heavier than it looks. The niche seems darker now.

ev.shrine2.title: The Drowned Shrine
ev.shrine2.text: A shrine half-swallowed by the cistern. Candle stubs float against the step.

effects.text: They take, one by one. The water settles.

ev.shrine3.title: The Ossuary Shrine
ev.shrine3.text: Someone laid these bones out with care. A censer hangs above them, still faintly warm.

effects.text: The smoke smells of cut grass. Nothing here objects.
Every skull in the wall is facing you now. They were not before.

ev.scribe.title: The Last Scribe
ev.scribe.text: A figure sits at the far desk, still copying. He does not look up when you enter, but he speaks.

effects.text: "Names. All of them. Someone has to."

choices.label: Ask him to open the vault

effects.text: He sighs, and somewhere behind you a bolt draws back.

choices.label: Offer to carry the ledger out

effects.text: "Then it will be read. That is all I wanted."

ev.camp.title: A Sheltered Nook
ev.camp.text: A dry alcove out of the draught. Someone camped here once; the ash is cold but the stones are still stacked.

effects.text: You sleep badly, but you sleep.
A charcoal map, scratched on slate. Whoever drew it was thorough.

testParties.label: Test party — level 1
testParties.note: Fresh, as a new player would begin. Starting kit and gold.

testParties.label: Test party — level 12 (max)
testParties.note: Fully levelled, best gear, every spell. For exercising late-game flow.

testParties.label: Test party — level 5, with a rogue
testParties.note: A fighter, a rogue, a priest and a wizard, part-way down. Starting gear, 800 gold, and rope, a crowbar, oil and caltrops.

sk.guard.name: Guard
sk.guard.blurb: Stand over an ally; melee meant for them finds you instead

sk.riposte.name: Riposte
sk.riposte.blurb: Set your feet; anything that misses you gets answered

sk.cleave.name: Cleave
sk.cleave.blurb: One swing across three of their front rank, at reduced force

sk.taunt.name: Challenge
sk.taunt.blurb: They come for you and nobody else, for two rounds

sk.wall.name: Shield Wall
sk.wall.blurb: +3 defence to everyone holding the front rank

sk.backstab.name: Backstab
sk.backstab.blurb: From the back rank, round the press: a blade in whatever your front rank is fighting. +2 to hit, a d6 more for every three levels, and a critical on anything not yet hurt

sk.hide.name: Melt Away
sk.hide.blurb: Out of sight for two rounds: nothing can aim at you, and your next blow comes from nowhere (+4 to hit). An Assassinate from hiding is surer still

sk.trick.name: Dirty Trick
sk.trick.blurb: A fistful of grit flung across their front rank, from either rank: for two rounds everything there fights half-blind, -3 to hit and 3 easier to hit. Golems and the like have no eyes to fill

sk.flurry.name: Knife Flurry
sk.flurry.blurb: Two knives thrown from either rank at anything in sight, -2 to hit each, a d4 apiece

sk.assassinate.name: Assassinate
sk.assassinate.blurb: Backstab's last lesson: +2 to hit and the sneak dice three times over, and anything but a boss left below a third of itself does not get up. From hiding (Melt Away) it needs nobody to keep them busy, always lands as a critical, and finishes anything left below half
